snippet.title: Orbital Maintenance Technician | Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Orbital Maintenance Technician | Official Gameplay Trailer

A maintenance simulator where you bring abandoned stations in deep space back to life. Clean up different types of damage with the right tools for each, repair faulty modules to get them running again, and restore the whole station to its former state.

🛰️ Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4579790/Orbital_Maintenance_Technician/
